title: What If Every Phone Used the Same Charger? The EU Did It

scenes.text: What if every phone used the same charger? The EU actually made it happen.
Since 28 December 2024, new phones, tablets, cameras and game consoles sold in the EU must charge with USB-C.
Discarded and unused chargers add up to about 11,000 tonnes of electronic waste every year.
The EU estimates shoppers spend about 250 million euros a year on chargers they don't need.
Apple had already dropped its Lightning port in its 2023 lineup, and laptops joined the rule in April 2026.
One cable in the drawer instead of five. How many dead chargers are in yours right now?

description:
What if every phone used the same charger?
The EU rule that took effect on 28 December 2024 requires USB-C on new devices, aiming to cut about 11,000 tonnes of charger waste a year.
